title: Almighty Maker! Lord of All
description: Almighty Maker! Lord of All in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 489 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Prayer for the Christian Temper”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Al-might-y Mak-er! Lord of all! Of life the on-ly spring! Cre-a-tor of un-num-bered worlds! Su-preme, E-ter-nal King!

lines: Drive from the confines of my heart
Nor let me, in forbidden paths,
Let not despair nor fell revenge
Oh! give me tears for others' woes,
I ask not wealth or fame;
Give me an eye to see thy will,
A heart to bless thy name.
May still my days serenely pass,

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
